title: RateLimiter copy-pasted verbatim between reader and transit admin
description: The RateLimiter struct, RateLimitState, and check_and_consume() implementation are copy-pasted identically between crates/reader/src/admin.rs and crates/transit/src/admin.rs. If the Retry-After bug (g9yy.1) is fixed in one, the other will silently diverge. Suggested rewrite: move RateLimiter into stoa-core or a shared internal module so both crates import it. The code is small enough that the shared module is not over-engineering — it's preventing the exact divergence that already exists in the module doc.
